extracted.name: Cocoa, Banana, and Peanut Butter Smoothie
extracted.description: This banana chocolate smoothie made with cocoa powder, honey, milk, and peanut butter is loaded with protein for a great post-workout drink.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 chopped frozen banana, or more to taste
